mobbin:74bc6276-56b0-44b9-9a2b-cd8ed27f6.summary: From event details the host taps 'Check In Guests', opens the QR camera, confirms the guest on a sliding panel, sees success with Undo, then scans the next guest.
steps: Guest panel identify and Check In
After check-in with times and Undo
steal: Scan, identify on a panel, then an explicit 'Check In' confirms before anything changes, which maps to equipment check-out (screens 2–3).
A list icon beside the camera is the manual fallback when the code will not scan (screens 2, 6).
A green 'Check In Successful' message keeps the camera live for continuous scan (screens 4–5).
'Undo Check In' with Registered and Checked In times corrects a wrong scan or already-in case right away (screen 5).
avoid: This flow has no unrecognized-code or already-checked-in error panel, only the normal case plus Undo after success (screens 2–6).
mobbin:74bc6276-56b0-44b9-9a2b-cd8ed27f6.fit: Inventory: extends automated check-out: host QR scan stands in for barcode or NFC on a kit, identify, confirm, then success; Undo covers mis-scan; list fallback covers failed scan.
